headline: Policy revisions on school safety and suicide prevention, plus new AP curriculum and textbooks, staff hires, and grants.
summary: The agenda lists policy changes on school safety, crisis management, and suicide prevention. It also covers new AP curriculum, textbook adoption, staff hires, and grant applications.
items: Recognize former staff members Dr. Ann Clark and Robert DeSantis
Recognize AP Capstone Scholars
Committee reports
Chair report
Superintendent report: Convocation 'Better Together', first day of school, budget update on financial efficiencies, LAS outcomes assessment report, AP results assessment report
Consent agenda: teacher hires, teacher leave of absence requests, teacher resignation, A1, A2, and A3 hires, sixth year salary credit, administrative hire at Greene Hills

Consent agenda grants: 2026-27 Alliance District Application, 21st Century Community Learning Centers summer funding, two ReadyCT Robotics grants, CSDE Family Resource Center grant, Primary Mental Health grant, State Adult Education, Peter R. Marsh Grant for BAIMS Music
Public comment
